verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs pack mentions CI/CD-adjacent capabilities (build/test automation, pipelines that 'collect audit-ready evidence automatically in every pipeline') but no explicit evidence pack entry describes deployment automation, environments, or continuous deployment features specifically. Community evidence is silent on deployment automation, focusing instead on unrelated performance/backup complaints. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deployment stages/environments, continuous deployment or release automation features, and independent/hands-on confirmation that deployments work reliably in pipelines.
